question: Estimate the number of people who own a smartphone in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Owners (have a smartphone in their personal use, even if shared family device)? Yes.
Active operational smartphones in personal use? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Smartphones in operation × people per device.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Operational smartphones in India (active devices): ~800M units.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Unique users with personal access to a smartphone: ~750M-800M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~80 crore smartphone owners in India.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: These probe daily usage and total demand: tea, milk, toothpaste, fuel, rice. The trick is per-capita consumption × population, with a sanity check from import/export/production data. Avoid double-counting between household and bulk/industrial channels.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Unique users with personal access to a smartphone

calculationFlow: Round: ~80 crore smartphone owners in India.

These probe daily usage and total demand: tea, milk, toothpaste, fuel, rice. The trick is per-capita consumption × population, with a sanity check from import/export/production data. Avoid double-counting between household and bulk/industrial channels.
